title: Limit beat pattern button size
prompt:
In lib/screens/songs/components/metronome_pattern_editor.dart, within _buildBeatRow, replace these exact lines:
                (subIndex) => Expanded(
                  child: _buildBeatModeButton(context, beatIndex, subIndex),
                ),
with:
                (subIndex) => Expanded(
                  child: Center(
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: 48,
                      child: _buildBeatModeButton(context, beatIndex, subIndex),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
This caps each square beat button at 48 logical pixels while allowing it to shrink in narrow subdivision columns. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- lib/screens/songs/components/metronome_pattern_editor.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/songs/components/metronome_pattern_editor.dart && flutter test test/screens/songs/metronome_pattern_editor_test.dart
